10/G.goal: Explain what cybersickness/VIMS is, identify symptoms that indicate its onset, and describe the internal user and hardware factors that can cause or increase it in VR systems.
10/G.achieves: Provides foundational understanding of a key psycho-physiological XR issue so the learner can recognize cybersickness-related usability concerns and understand how user and hardware choices affect VR acceptability.

10/O1.goal: Explain what cybersickness/VIMS is, identify symptoms that indicate its onset, and why reducing it matters for VR usability.
10/O1.achieves: Gives the learner a basic vocabulary and recognition basis for treating cybersickness as a usability and acceptability issue in virtual reality systems.

10/O2.goal: Describe how internal user factors and external hardware factors can cause or increase cybersickness in VR systems.
10/O2.achieves: Prepares the learner to connect cybersickness risk to user characteristics and hardware design choices, supporting later evaluation of VR usability, system design, and optimization.
